The fix works. Now `get_handle` with `memory_map=True` on an in-memory buffer raises `ValueError` with the required message instead of propagating `io.UnsupportedOperation`.

The change (in `pandas/io/common.py`, `_maybe_memory_map`): BytesIO exposes a `fileno()` method that raises `io.UnsupportedOperation` (a subclass of `OSError`) rather than returning a real descriptor, so `hasattr(handle, "fileno")` passes and the code reached the `mmap.mmap(handle.fileno(), ...)` call. I wrapped that in an `except OSError` that re-raises a `ValueError` with the required substring, chaining the original for context.
